boundary.resolution: Installed capacities/windows/reservations, linked system/cartridge sections, language slots/budget and execution domains are independently source-checked; none grants a guessed free arena or RAM isolation.
open: Complete shared-device-buffer ownership/admission/lifetime route and required call/permission reference.

registers.resolution: All four Memory-owned fault registers have exact byte address, access, full-word contents, code/flag values and explicit construction/clear words. Selected CPU status/cause/EXEC facts are not presented as the full COP0 reference.

datapath.resolution: Byte units, type/aggregate layout, static initializer limits, typed views, zero-based scaling, raw byte arithmetic, BE instructions versus LE data/records, scalar widths and exact worked storage are source-checked.
open: Complete required function-call/dynamic-value/string-byte programming contracts or finished owning references.

visibility.resolution: Generated startup versus EXEC/image selection, scalar alignment/readiness, immediate fault publication/ACK and F64 ordered partial completion are explicit and source-checked.
open: Complete device capture-versus-live-read, completion/fault and buffer-reuse/overlap boundaries.

timing.resolution: Installed33,868,800cycle timebase and selected scalar-memory/arithmetic/WIDE base charges are explicit; no source-expression duration or electrical bandwidth is inferred.
open: Complete required instruction/access timing reference and cross-unit DMA budgets; record the software-defined limits rather than invent separate electrical bus clocks.

interrupts.resolution: BIOS central mask0 handoff, CPU IE/user entry bits, synchronous access exceptions and independent CPU cause/IRQ/NMI bits are distinguished.
open: Connect complete central interrupt setup and supervisor/handler programming to the newcomer route.

faults.resolution: First-pending words versus new fault sequence, exact codes/ACCESS, nonzero ACK, alignment-before-map and faulting-load destination behavior pass source audit.
open: Complete supervisor/handler privilege, reporting, return/retry or terminal-fault policy and an actual fault-inspection/recovery programming route.

reset.resolution: System reset/startup, BIOS selection/handoff, arbitrary EXEC and repeated own DATA/BSS initialization are source-checked; no blanket RAM-zero or persistence promise is made.
open: Establish the required inherited device/register/buffer state and corresponding cartridge initialization/ownership rules.

programming.resolution: Complete32- and30-line typed BLua modules exactly match the ordinary cartridge; full validation and its integration case pass initial DATA/BSS, all layouts/relative addresses/words/padding and final status.
open: Complete public packaging/launch/inspection workflow or a finished programming-guide reference, shared-device-buffer use and whole-reader acceptance.
